verdict.rationale: OpenTofu configs and state are plain-text HCL/JSON files stored locally or in backends, and state encryption is open/documented, meaning data isn't locked into a proprietary format and can be exported/migrated freely; it's also open-source and license info is on GitHub. However there's no explicit 'export all data' feature or documented data-portability workflow beyond the inherent openness of IaC files, and no evidence of a formal data-export/offboarding tool. missing for 10: explicit data-export tooling/documentation, independent confirmation of full data portability, and clear on-site licensing/export guidance (community notes license info is hard to find on the site).
